title: Anti Skynet Treaty
definition: A treaty advocating for the decentralization and distribution of understanding, with machines helping humans see, rather than taking over the world.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A promise that machines will not take over the world, but will help humans understand it instead.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A treaty promoting the decentralization and distribution of understanding, ensuring that machines aid humans rather than replacing them.
difficulty_levels.expert: A philosophical agreement emphasizing the importance of decentralization, distribution of understanding, and the collaboration between humans and machines, to prevent the rise of a Skynet-like scenario.

extra_fields.insight: The idea that machines should help humans see and understand the world, rather than taking over it.
